[[File:Charles Lund Facebook portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Charles Lund.]]
'''Charles Lund''' of Coral Gables, Florida, won a 1996 Hoth Contest daily anagram with [[Death Mark]].<ref name="hoth">[http://games.decipher.com/hothcontest/puzzle09.html Death Mark], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961102055013/http://games.decipher.com:80/hothcontest/puzzle09.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 43, from Coral Gables, FL. After Decipher's SWCCG run, the slot was marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Inducted in December 1996, he was a Flight Leader and co-created Rebel Gamers of Miami (later Rebel Gamers of South Florida).<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I am the co-creator of Rebel Gamers of Miami, which grew into Rebel Gamers of South Florida soon enough. I am 22 years old, and was one of the youngest Squadron Members when I was inducted in Dec. 1996. My room is almost a shrine to Star Wars, and it would have more, but I can't afford to get my posters framed!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
